const urls = [
  ["linux_sb", "https://linux.sb/"],
  ["yucoder", "https://yucoder.cn/index"],
  ["foreverblog", "https://www.foreverblog.cn/index.php"],
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "let i=0;",
  "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
  "async function next(){",
  "  if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
  "  const s=cfg.urls[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(s[1]);",
  "  await sleep(7000);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:s[1],headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36','Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',async function(){",
  "      let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      b=b.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
  "      b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/“/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/”/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/…/g,'...');",
  "      b=b.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      console.log('===== '+s[0]+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
  "      console.log(b.substring(0,3800));",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('===== '+s[0]+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-alt12.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-alt12.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch three new community homepages", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 14000));
